description: This source file defines React context and hooks for managing the state of a sidebar component (whether it is open or closed). It includes creation of context, a provider component, and a custom hook for consuming the context.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: React component that provides sidebar state (open/closed) and toggle function to its children via context.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom hook that allows components to access sidebar state and toggle function from context.
